content: Pull my recent activities and give me a plan for the weekend.

Your recent rides were **90min endurance on July 1 (Load 55)** and **2h tempo on July 3 (Load 85)**. Latest readiness looks good: **Fitness 55, Fatigue 48, Form +7**, with stable HRV/resting HR and 7.5h sleep.

## Saturday — Sweet spot + endurance, ~2h
Warmup: 15min at 50–65% FTP  
Main: 3×12min at 88–92% FTP, 5min easy at 50–55% between  
Endurance: 45min at 60–70% FTP  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated Intensity: ~0.72  
Estimated Load: ~100–110  
Why: A controlled aerobic-quality session without creating excessive fatigue.

## Sunday — Easy endurance, 90min
Warmup: 10min at 50–60% FTP  
Main: 70min at 60–70% FTP, conversational effort  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated Intensity: ~0.64  
Estimated Load: ~55–65  
Why: Adds aerobic volume while helping you absorb Saturday.

If your legs feel unusually heavy Saturday, skip the sweet-spot blocks and ride entirely at 60–70% FTP.
